ceremony-details: Please arrive 30 minutes early to be seated. The ceremony will be outdoors — we recommend light, comfortable formal attire.
reception-details: Please join us for an evening of celebration filled with good food, music, and laughter! Valet parking will be available on-site for your convenience.
itinerary-subheader: Here’s a look at the special moments planned for our big day.
welcome-itinerary-description: Take a seat and enjoy the serene surroundings before the ceremony.
ceremony-itinerary-description: Be part of a beautiful outdoor ceremony as we officially begin this new chapter together.
cocktails-itinerary-description: Sip, mingle, and enjoy good company as the evening unfolds.
reception-itinerary-description: Join us for dinner, laughter, and dancing as we celebrate into the night.
our-story-paragraph-1: It all started with a little digital nudge in Orange County/Los Angeles — a swipe in the right direction turned into a journey neither of us expected. Since then, we’ve sharedlaughter, road trips, and dreams that keep growing bigger together.
our-story-paragraph-2: Now, we can’t wait to celebrate this next chapter surrounded by our favorite people. Thank you for being part of our story.
rsvp-subheader: We’d love to know if you can join us in celebrating our wedding day. Please RSVP by January 20, 2026 so we can plan accordingly.
solo-rsvp-message: Please let us know if you’ll be joining us.
group-rsvp-message: Please let us know who from your group will be joining us.
contact-info-message: Please share your contact info — we might have a little something to send your way
optional-message-placeholder: Add a personal note or details about your RSVP.
please-select-at-least-one-guest: Who’s coming? Select at least one guest to join the fun!
rsvp-success-message: Thank you for letting us know!
rsvp-already-submitted-message: It looks like you’ve already submitted your RSVP. If you need to make changes, please contact us directly.
additional-details-subheader: Here’s everything you might want to know to help plan your time with us.
dress-code-description: Formal attire is requested. Gentlemen, please wear suits or dress shirts and ties. Ladies, dresses or formal evening wear are perfect.
parking-description: Complimentary parking is available at the venue. Rideshare is encouraged if you plan to enjoy drinks during the reception.
reception-menu-description: Dinner will be casual buffet style with food stations, featuring a mix of our favorite comfort foods. (Tacos by Leo's Taco Truck and Pho by Cater Pho You)
gifts-description: Your presence means the world to us! For those who wish to give a gift, we are registered at Minted.
gift-message: Your presence is the best gift! If you’d like to give a gift, you can find our registry at Minted.
thank-you-message: Thank you for celebrating with us! After the wedding, please return to this website to see all the photos and relive the memories from our special day.
